nodes.summary: Positions `i` and `j` of `s` both lie in `s` and carry complementary bases.
nodes.title: Complementary base pairing of two positions

nodes.summary: The number of secondary structures on `n` points with minimum hairpin `m`, when every pair of positions may pair, is Waterman's number `S_m(n)`.
nodes.title: Counting semiring

nodes.summary: An additive base-pair energy model: the free energy of a structure is the sum of the energies `e i j` of its base pairs (in the same units as `RT`).
nodes.title: Additive base-pair energy model

nodes.summary: McCaskill's algorithm (inside part): over the sum-product semiring `ℝ` with Boltzmann weights `exp (-e i j / RT)`, the inside value of the whole sequence is the partition function. This is an algebraic identity valid for every real `RT`.
nodes.title: McCaskill's algorithm

nodes.summary: The inside value of the whole sequence sums the weights of all its secondary structures.
nodes.title: Inside value sums the weights of all secondary structures

nodes.summary: The inside recursion sums the weights of all secondary structures supported in the interval `[i, i + len)`, over any commutative semiring.
nodes.title: Inside algorithm

nodes.summary: With every base pair weighted `-1` in the min-plus semiring `MinTropical (WithTop ℤ)` (addition `min`, multiplication `+`), a structure with `k` pairs has weight `-k`, so the inside value of the whole sequence is minus the Nussinov maximum number of base pairs.
nodes.title: Tropical semiring

nodes.summary: Inside recursion over a commutative semiring `R`: `inside pair m s w i len` is the weighted sum over the secondary structures supported in the interval `[i, i + len)` (proved in `inside_eq_sum`). Base `i` is either unpaired, or paired with `i + 1 + k` for some `k ≥ m` with `CanPair pair s i (i + 1 + k)`, which contributes `w i (i + 1 + k)` times the inside values of the enclosed interval `[i + 1, i + 1 + k)` and of…
nodes.title: Inside recursion

nodes.summary: `structures` is exactly the set of secondary structures on `s`.
nodes.title: Membership in the set of secondary structures

nodes.summary: For nonnegative weights the total weight of all structures is at least `1`, the weight of the empty structure; so the denominator of `pairProb` is positive.
nodes.title: Total structure weight is at least one

nodes.summary: Outside algorithm (McCaskill 1990): for a candidate pair `(i, j)` (`i + m < j` and `CanPair pair s i j`), the outside value times the pair's weight times the inside value of the enclosed interval `[i + 1, j)` sums the weights of all secondary structures containing `(i, j)`.
nodes.title: Outside algorithm

nodes.summary: Outside recursion (McCaskill 1990) over a commutative semiring `R`, for a sequence of length `n = s.length`: `outside pair m s w i j` is the weighted sum of the parts outside the pair `(i, j)` of all structures containing it (proved in `outside_mul_eq_sum`). Either no pair encloses `(i, j)`, leaving independent structures on `[0, i)` and `[j + 1, n)`, or there is a unique innermost enclosing pair `(a, b)` (`a < i`,…
nodes.title: Outside recursion

nodes.summary: For a candidate pair `(i, j)`, `P(i, j) = outside(i, j) · w(i, j) · inside(i + 1, j) / inside(0, n)`.
nodes.title: McCaskill's base-pair probabilities

nodes.summary: Base-pair probabilities are nonnegative for nonnegative weights.
nodes.title: Nonnegativity of base-pair probabilities

nodes.summary: The base-pair probability `P(i, j)`: the total weight of the structures containing the pair `(i, j)`, divided by the total weight `Z` of all structures. For nonnegative weights `Z ≥ 1` (the empty structure has weight `1`), so the denominator is positive; for Boltzmann weights this is the probability of `(i, j)` under the Boltzmann distribution on structures.
nodes.title: Base-pair probability

nodes.summary: The partition function `Z = ∑_S exp (-E(S) / RT)` over all secondary structures `S` on `s` with minimum hairpin `m`, for the additive energy `e` at thermal energy `RT` (physically `0 < RT`; the identities below hold for every real `RT`).
nodes.title: McCaskill partition function of RNA secondary structures

nodes.summary: The secondary structures on `s` (`IsStructure pair m s`) all of whose pairs lie in the interval `[i, i + len)`.
nodes.title: Secondary structures within an interval

nodes.summary: All secondary structures on `s` with minimum hairpin `m` (see `mem_structures`).
nodes.title: Set of all secondary structures of a sequence

nodes.summary: For nonnegative weights, the probabilities that base `i` pairs with some later base `j` or some earlier base `j` sum to at most `1` (`∑_j (P(i, j) + P(j, i)) ≤ 1`).
nodes.title: Each base pairs at most once

nodes.summary: For `m = 0` (no hairpin constraint) Waterman's numbers are the Motzkin numbers `M(n) = ∑_k C(n, 2k) C(k)`: the number of non-crossing partial matchings on `n` points.
nodes.title: Waterman numbers with no hairpin constraint are Motzkin numbers

nodes.summary: Waterman's recursion for the number `S_m(n)` of secondary structures on `n` points with minimum hairpin `m` when every pair is allowed: `S(0) = 1` and `S(n + 1) = S(n) + ∑_{m ≤ k < n} S(k) S(n - 1 - k)` (Waterman 1978; Stein–Waterman 1979). For `m = 0` these are the Motzkin numbers (`watermanNumber_zero_eq_motzkinNumber`); for `m = 1` the Stein–Waterman numbers `1, 1, 1, 2, 4, 8, 17, 37, …` (OEIS A004148).
nodes.title: Waterman's recursion

nodes.summary: The weight of a structure: the product of the weights of its base pairs.
nodes.title: Weight of a secondary structure

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
